_comment: FunctionGemma 270M — primary local tool calling for Gama. See core/functiongemma_router.py.
_enabled_comment: When true (and torch+transformers+model available), FunctionGemma is the primary local tool router on verified transcripts. When false or model missing, falls back to regex fast-intent → Flash-Lite → Gemini Live.
_model_path_comment: Empty = auto-resolve: models/functiongemma_ft/ → models/functiongemma-270m-it/ → google/functiongemma-270m-it on Hugging Face Hub. Set to a local folder with config.json for offline use.
_max_new_tokens_comment: Max tokens for a single tool-call generation. 64–128 is enough for name+args.
_preload_on_startup_comment: Warm the model in the background startup preloader so the first command avoids cold-load latency.
